name: Oh That's Why English
style: clean hand-drawn 2D editorial illustration, explainer-video style, bold simple shapes, soft flat colours with gentle grain texture, crisp dark outlines, one consistent palette for every scene: warm cream background, charcoal outlines, teal and soft orange accents, simple uncluttered background, clear single subject, not a photo, not 3D render, vertical composition, leave the top third uncluttered for a title
voice_note: Stock Gemini voice in 'voices'. 'voice_trial' (Prashant's cloned voice) overrides it while running/kept.

voice_trial.name: clone
voice_trial.note: Prashant's cloned voice for 5 videos. factory/analyze.py judges it once all 5 are 72 h old; the script run then sets status to kept or reverted. reverted = back to the stock Gemini voice in 'voices'.

delivery_note: Scene 'delivery' is one of: warm, curious, lean-in, build, reveal, light, serious (factory/tts.py DELIVERY). Keep styles short: Google says long style text makes the voice drift.

engagement.note: Prashant 2026-11-13: hook people in the first ~2 s and keep them (open loop, mid re-hook, late payoff); end every video with a guess about TOMORROW's topic; the first 3 right answers (across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook) get their names on screen in the next video. Checked by factory/render.py check_engagement; names picked by factory/quiz.py at render time.
